serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Lemma is Thread AI's AI workflow orchestration platform, deployed in AWS GovCloud (US) for federal customers and the contractors that support them.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Thread AI trust center hosting security documentation and compliance reports. FedRAMP Certification Data is published separately at the certification package overview URI and needs no access request.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: FedRAMP Certification Data is public and requires no access request. Gated materials (the SOC 2 Type II report and the certification package) are available by submitting an access request on the trust center page; requests are reviewed and granted by the security team.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Certification package documents and the SOC 2 Type II report.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Submit an access request on the trust center page. Requests are reviewed and granted by the Thread AI security team.

contactInformation.contactName: FedRAMP Security Inbox (routes to Senior Security Official)

certifiedServices.serviceDescription:
Lemma is offered as a single service comprising the orchestration runtime, workflow builder, SDK, API, and Lemma Workers; all are included and none is separately licensed or deployed.

Security category: Low (FIPS 199).

Not included: Thread AI's commercial service, which runs in a separate environment, and any deployment into customer-controlled infrastructure such as a customer VPC or an on-premises installation.

certified.useCase: AWS GovCloud (US) provides all infrastructure underneath the offering (compute, storage, networking, KMS, logging). Inherited controls per the AWS GovCloud Customer Responsibility Matrix.
Okta IDaaS Regulated Cloud is the workforce identity provider for the boundary; it federates administrative and operator access into AWS IAM Identity Center via SCIM.
